name: Dictation Quill

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight.

summary: Writes down what you say, 25 words a minute, for up to an hour.
text: As a Magic action you set the quill to work: it writes down the words you speak or sign, 25 words a minute, on paper and ink you provide. It stops after 1 hour, when the paper or ink runs out, or when you tell it to.

params.text: scratches down every word you say
